premise: Rain begins; Mushroom offers her cap to Ladybug, then Bee, then Butterfly, and stretches a little wider each time so everyone stays dry.
inspiration: The Mitten (Ukrainian folk tale), turned: the shelter grows instead of bursting, and the shy one turns out to be bigger than she looks.
lesson: There is always room for one more if you stretch a little.

en-US.title: Mushroom's Umbrella
en-US.text: {bee:float loop 0.3} {butterfly:float loop 0.4} Mushroom {mushroom:pulse} was small and shy and had a cap like a little umbrella. One afternoon the sky went grey. {canvas:rain 0.6 18s} {sfx:rain} Plip. Plop. Pitter-patter. [surprised] Oh! said Ladybug. {ladybug:hop} My wings are getting wet! Come under my cap, said Mushroom, very quietly. Ladybug squeezed under. Dry! Bzzz — here came Bee, {bee:wobble} damp. Is there room? Mushroom stretched her cap a little wider. {mushroom:pulse 0.8} Squeak. Come in. Then Butterfly {butterfly:wobble x2} fluttered down, dripping. Room for one more? Mushroom stretched… and stretched… {mushroom:pulse 1} and there was. The rain drummed on the cap. {sfx:tap solo} Underneath, three friends and a mushroom listened, warm and dry. [giggles] You are bigger than you look, said Bee. [softly] Only when I need to be, said Mushroom. And when the rain stopped, she did not shrink back. [happily] Just in case.

es-ES.title: El paraguas de Seta
es-ES.text: {bee:float loop 0.3} {butterfly:float loop 0.4} Seta {mushroom:pulse} era pequeña y tímida y tenía un sombrero como un paraguas chiquitito. Una tarde el cielo se puso gris. {canvas:rain 0.6 18s} {sfx:rain} Plic. Ploc. Tip-tap, tip-tap. [surprised] ¡Ay!, dijo Mariquita. {ladybug:hop} ¡Se me mojan las alas! Ven bajo mi sombrero, dijo Seta, muy bajito. Mariquita se coló debajo. ¡Seca! Bzzz: llegó Abeja, {bee:wobble} empapada. ¿Hay sitio? Seta estiró el sombrero un poquito más. {mushroom:pulse 0.8} Ñic. Pasa. Luego bajó Mariposa {butterfly:wobble x2} chorreando. ¿Cabe una más? Seta estiró… y estiró… {mushroom:pulse 1} y cupo. La lluvia tamborileaba en el sombrero. {sfx:tap solo} Debajo, tres amigas y una seta escuchaban, calentitas y secas. [giggles] Eres más grande de lo que pareces, dijo Abeja. [softly] Solo cuando hace falta, dijo Seta. Y cuando paró de llover, no volvió a encogerse. [happily] Por si acaso.

rain.prompt: a soft afternoon rain shower on leaves and moss, steady and gentle

tap.prompt: raindrops tapping on a small round mushroom cap, close and cosy, like a tiny drum
